title: Low grade gem stone, not for the serious collector, more for kids.
text:
Low grade gem stone, not for the serious collector, more for kids.. I Wasn’t sure what I was going to recieve in this gem package!

I recieved a very small white geode , that was broken in half with white crystals inside.
4 small almost white rose quartz, and one light color amethyst crystal that was larger then all the other ones put together, although a very light color.
What the picture and colors show, is not what I recieved.

These would be nice for a young collector.
My 7 yr old granddaughter likes this collection, and does know a little about the rocks..We live on a river in California where there
Are many other types of gems, crystals in the river, and all around us .
She is excited about these.

I have to say, I have been collecting crystals, rocks, gem stones for years. Started out collecting cause I just loved the rocks, then got more Serious with using crystals for meditation, and I also have large gem rocks etc. and books.

If your a serious collector this is not for you. These in my opinion are all a low grade.
These will look nice in house plant pots, and , they will give off some energy, and look good.
